d:
A floating, spherical entity composed of swirling cosmic energy. Large, glowing white eyes set into a featureless face. Ageless, cosmic maturity. A perfect spherical body surrounded by a ring of rotating planetary debris. Lacks traditional clothing, enveloped in a shimmering gold and purple aura. Possesses no arms or legs, but emits flares of solar energy from its core.
BODY COLOR: golden yellow
